name: Piste
idea: An épée scoring box you can set off — both lamps, with the real 40ms lockout.

name: Scope
idea: A bench oscilloscope. Four real signals, a timebase and a gain that do what they say.

name: Notebook
idea: A bound lab notebook on a desk: ruled paper, dated entries, one open at a time.

name: Silkscreen
idea: A circuit board with layers you can turn off, the way a CAD tool does it.

name: Wall label
idea: An exhibition hung sideways — one object to a wall, with its label.

name: Drift
idea: A screen suspended in a space with three depths, its edges fading into it.

name: Datasheet
idea: A component datasheet: title block, abs-max ratings, and a pin map you can poke.

name: Broadsheet
idea: A newspaper in real columns, with a measure control that changes the layout.

name: Bout sheet
idea: Mostly a results table, sortable, with the totals recomputed from the rows.

name: Card index
idea: A box of index cards you riffle through, one tab at a time.

name: Plotter
idea: Pen-plotter output: every stroke drawn at a constant pen speed, with pens you can lift.

name: Floor plan
idea: Four rooms. The plan tracks where you are as you read through them.

name: Reel
idea: One frame to a year, scrubbed through on a transport.

name: Specimen
idea: A type specimen. No colour at all — measure and leading are the controls.

name: Memory map
idea: An address space from reset vector to stack, blocks drawn to scale.

name: Blueprint
idea: A dimensioned drawing with a title block, and line types you can switch off.

name: Receipt
idea: A till slip, printed. Serrated at both ends, barcode encoded from the name.

name: Transit
idea: Three lines and one interchange; each stop is a real anchor into its entry.

name: Poster
idea: One screen, two inks, slightly out of register — and the register follows you.

name: Punch card
idea: Four 80-column cards in real IBM 029 keypunch code.
